New decision "Chose SHOULD over MUST for OVERRIDE-03 (commit .twining promptly after lifecycle writes)" relates to:
- 01KJJAP0N95VJ7YTNDCGH5DX7B: "Skip ONNX embedding initialization in test environment via process.env.VITEST check"
- 01KQV935ZDSEV81DRC75NZW77T: "Updated test expectations to match actual server behavior: tests verify TWINING_DISABLED=true exits cleanly within 300ms while other cases attempt normal startup"
- 01KX3SE6GQZDF5Q3NYE73472TB: "Seed fixture writes through the concrete store classes (the one allowed direct-class use, as dev tooling) with deterministic mulberry32 PRNG and post-hoc timestamp spread over 18 months with bursts"
- 01KX4CDPNEQ638R6VNR4TATZAN: "Accepted reviewer-flagged behavior as-is: depth-1 nodes never visited by the depth-2 walk emit no overflow entry"
- 01KX4D8F24TSWW2FRPRJY48Z6H: "Accepted implementer judgment: health-report staleness scores decisions only"
- 01KY11ZFFRWAZPXM6T031BT28A: "Chose to exclude superseded decisions from twining_why by default (include_superseded opt-in, superseded_count always reported)"
- 01KY15ZAPP4531T7JM538XW5Z8: "Chose to switch three legacy archiver tests from warning/need fixtures to finding/status rather than passing keep_open_needs_warnings: false"
- 01KY6EEVPMYETW0KDG2Y2N2RPB: "Chose to re-run 5 of 8 adversarial review dimensions in a second workflow round after discovering the Workflow args object was stringified by the harness, making args.spec resolve to undefined"
- 01KY72PJDHF4GG3YJ6TGG7109Z: "Chose to scope the §5.3 computeResolvedIds refactor to the two true near-copies (archiver.ts:61-63, blackboard.ts:164-174) plus buildTriage, explicitly excluding verify.ts:226-244"
- 01KY72PJGW8VVC20DG0VBW87TS: "Chose the minimal-honest resolution for the reconsider companion-warning residue (documented limitation + twining_dismiss named as drain + §10 test pinning v1 treatment + §11.2 system-tag prerequisite extended to decisions.ts:737) over making promote/override auto-resolve the warning"
- 01KY73F5CFN40D1R0TDQKMEEG5: "Chose to also refactor sqlite-stores.ts's three byte-identical scope-match sites onto scopeMatches, beyond the spec §5.1 list of the three file-backend stores"
- 01KY73TDB6V4Y1TV762J3R4VDN: "Chose a direct code-unit </> comparator for the (timestamp,id) ordering over the repo's localeCompare convention"
- 01KY73TDEBFKPTV819QDVD2YKH: "Chose default parameters for buildTriage's now (() => new Date()) and input ({}) following the isDelegationExpired default-clock convention"
- 01KY73TDGKZK5RW05NDVD2RGNB: "Chose to define TriageInput/TriageStores in src/engine/triage.ts rather than types.ts"
- 01KY74RAFG84P9SAP9B4GZXKSZ: "Chose to build the uninitialized zero shape by running the real buildTriage over module-level empty stub stores (EMPTY_TRIAGE_STORES, Partial-cast) over hand-writing the zero JSON"
- 01KY74RAHZJW6ECQWJZS0P2ZM1: "Chose to pin storage backend to 'files' via config.yml in the HTTP-adapter test fixtures"
- 01KY752JSWD6B2PET59KAB56XB: "Chose to render the irreversible decision badge with the existing 'badge urgency-high' class (error palette) over adding a new 'badge irreversible' CSS rule"
- 01KY793E9J4PX0F2HYP953J614: "Chose to apply window_ms=Infinity as an unbounded window (cutoff -Infinity) over silently defaulting it to 7 days"
- 01KY79612EJTET32SSP79Y6C0X: "Chose to extend the scopeMatches extraction to the three byte-identical sqlite-stores.ts sites beyond the spec's file-store list"
- 01KY79619957FWQ8BTCZ2K9AFH: "Chose window_ms: Infinity as an unbounded window per spec §4.1's 'no upper clamp'"
- 01KY7961CJGC3FB049TTNVG09K: "Chose controller-staged commits in the spec's four PR stages over a single squash"
- 01KY7VWPN31TAF5SFG8NMHGHNX: "Chose a needs-human TAG convention with client-side band/badge over a mechanism field or new bucket"
- 01KY87YQ9QS28BRZGENSS6KCR7: "Chose to verify tool-created decisions via twining_why in integration tests instead of reading decision JSON files"
- 01KY89JXV839CDZ941JWQDEDEQ: "Chose to gate provisional minting via twining_record behind tools.full_surface (per-decision error, decision NOT recorded) over co-registering promote/override on the default surface"
- 01KZ6J7BGBSFRNF16JY96D5CNY: "Chose to add a durable store snapshot step (DataCollector.saveTwiningStoreSnapshot) called from the orchestrator before teardown, rather than leaving the analyzer unrunnable —"
- 01KZ6J7BHT5SG37M9HENGC3Q05: "Chose to verify test discrimination by systematic mutation rather than the project's standard git stash push src/ check —"
- 01KZW6QZ1Y2A4NYADDE08FBA18: "Rejected field ask D12(a) rank-by-recency-x-severity as specified"
- 01KZXVQG1HYKK6JYGKD5HBHHHE: "Chose age stamps only for handoffs >=1 day old"
- 01M04FDHWSBZ1TTKSSJPVK7AFA: "Chose to change IDecisionStore.updateStatus to return {persisted: boolean} rather than throw NOT_FOUND on missing targets"
